eligibilitySummary.zhTw: 適用於居住在瑞士境外的旅客；含稅零售價須至少 CHF 300，離境時須向瑞士海關出示商品與出口文件。退款由賣方依交易關係處理。
eligibilitySummary.enUs: Available to travelers domiciled outside Switzerland when the VAT-inclusive retail price is at least CHF 300; goods and the export document must be presented to Swiss Customs on exit. Any reimbursement is handled by the seller under the sales relationship.

content.scope: Jurisdiction-level traveler consumption-tax policy only; this does not establish Rolex retailer participation, an individual purchaser's eligibility, or a guaranteed refund amount.
observedFacts: Tax exemption for tourist purchases applies only when all stated conditions are met, including a buyer domiciled outside Switzerland and a retail price of at least CHF 300 including VAT.
The traveler must present the goods and completed export document to Swiss customs when leaving Swiss territory.
The buyer cannot claim Swiss VAT from the authorities; any reimbursement is handled by the supplier under the sales relationship.
limitations: The source does not establish that every retailer offers a refund after export confirmation.
Rolex retailer participation and any processing fee are not established by this evidence.
